body_html:
As a note just wanted to share I am more of a consumer of #indieweb tools rather than a producer. Been trying to apply the principles in my #highered classes with a bunch of other #digped folks tracing lineage to #ds106 and #rhizo15 #rhizo16

Hopped back into the community. Funny what you find you have time for when you quit facebook.
